# #2048: Patch: spec check holds every `(ruling)` and `Ruling:` marker in §2–§10 to a `[[R…]]` link
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The rulebook is dotted with phrases like "Cap 10 (ruling)" and "Ruling: name it Bread Token" — markers saying a numbered ruling decides this point. Most link to their ruling note; about a dozen link nowhere, so a reader cannot follow them, and the audit checklist that requires every marker to map to a ruling is enforced only by hand. After this patch every marker links to its ruling and the checker keeps it that way.

## Why

REVIEW.md's A2.3 requires every `(ruling)`/`Ruling:` marker in §2–§10 to map to a §11 row; nothing enforces it. Verified unlinked markers whose notes exist: `spec/03-zones.md:7` ("Cap 10 (ruling)" — `R0317.md` exists), `spec/06-keywords.md:101` (Fatigue's "(ruling)" — `R0003.md`), `spec/07-tokens.md:159-160` ("Ruling: name it Bread Token" — `R0037.md`; the Reminisce ruling beside it), plus more across §3–§8. The convention already exists: `spec/03-zones.md:22` ends its marker `([[R5]])`.

## Proposal

A new spec-check rule beside `unresolved_markers` (crates/tools/src/spec.rs:114): every `(ruling)`/`Ruling:` marker in spec/02–10 must carry a `[[R…]]` link that resolves. Add the missing links in the same PR; if a marker genuinely has no ruling note, either write one (numbered from the PR's issue block, with its proving test per CLAUDE.md rule 3) or reword the marker — a small number of sites, decided case by case and recorded in the PR.

## Where it lands

`crates/tools/src/spec.rs`, `spec/02`–`10` marker lines, possibly one or two new `spec/rulings/R*.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` fails on an unlinked `(ruling)`/`Ruling:` marker
- [ ] Every existing marker links to a resolving ruling
- [ ] Any new ruling note has a proving test and a `proven_in` entry, with `spec index` regenerated

## Size and risks

Small-medium: a checker rule plus link fixes. The only open end is a marker with no ruling — the PR writes the note or removes the marker, each recorded.
